name: jassimp
input_api: Jassimp.importFile(String local filename); AiScene.getMeshes(); AiMesh.getNumVertices() and getNumFaces()
family: JAssimp JNI binding over native Assimp PLY importer
family_note: Separately published Maven Java binding; JNI built from tagged source against pinned Assimp 6.0.6. Shares native Assimp PLY parser family with LWJGL Assimp, MonkeyWrench, and C/C++ Assimp call sites.

name: vofxel
input_api: new PlyParser(InputStream).parse() returns VertexList with coordinate and RGB fields
family: Vofxel native Java colored ASCII PLY vertex reader
family_note: Separate Java vertex reader. Its released parser reads six-column coordinate/RGB rows after end_header; it does not expose faces or validate other PLY header fields. No shared underlying parser family was found.
scope: Eight colored ASCII PLY voxel vertices; first X and red value, last Z coordinate; no faces
